patch_description: Add a gated, dynamics-blended third forward/backward RTS pass as a post-processing stage. A new helper function runs a third Kalman forward+RTS cycle on the two-pass output with q3 = qa/16 (4x geometric decay), estimated from the data. It is skipped when the two-pass output has already converged (max |second difference| < 0.05 sigma_r), and the third-pass result is blended back with a tanh-squashed curvature weight so that noise-dominated segments receive extra smoothing while genuine turns are preserved. This is implemented entirely at the dispatcher's return site so it composes with the existing two-pass smoother without touching its internals.
